title: Brighton Fringe Used My Personal Phone for Box Office, Then Blamed Me for Collapse
claim: Brighton Fringe intervened to protect the public and their reputation because I was no longer operational.
reality: A member of the public called me, believing my number was the official Brighton Fringe support line. This proves the Brighton Fringe ticketing and performer tracking system had failed. I was fielding customer service calls, describing visible collapse, trying to salvage their reputation, and contemplating going rogue to ensure the shows could go ahead — while being blamed and erased.

laws.act: Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008
laws.why: The public had no access to performer or event contact details.
Failure to act transparently and protect public safety.
